### Changing Your Seat Type (Same-Flight Edit)
Since your booking is **Business class**, all changes — including seat type, meal preference, and add-ons (WiFi, extra legroom, insurance) — are **free of charge**. No change fee applies. You can switch your seat from aisle to window (or middle) at no cost anytime before departure.

### Changing to a Different Flight
- **Change fee:** **$0** — Business class passengers enjoy **free flight changes**.
- **Fare difference:** If the new flight has a higher fare, you would pay the difference. If it's lower, the difference is refunded to your original payment method.

### General Change Rules
| Scenario | Fee |
|---|---|
| **Business class — any change** | **Free** (fare difference still applies) |
| First class — any change | Free (fare difference still applies) |
| Economy domestic — personal, >7 days out | $75 + fare difference |
| Economy domestic — personal, ≤7 days out | $150 + fare difference |
| Economy international — personal, >7 days out | $100 + fare difference |
| Economy international — personal, ≤7 days out | $200 + fare difference |

### Special Circumstances (Fee Waivers/Discounts)
These apply regardless of cabin class:
- **Medical reason:** 50% discount on standard fee
- **Bereavement:** 75% discount on standard fee
- **Jury duty / Military deployment:** Free change
- **Airline schedule change / Weather:** Free change

### Your Booking Summary
- **Cabin Class:** Business → **Free changes**
- **Current Seat:** Aisle
- **Departure:** October 15, 2026 (4+ months away)
- **Status:** Confirmed ✅

**Bottom line:** If you'd like to change your seat type (e.g., from aisle to window), there is **no fee at all**. Would you like me to make that change for you?
